verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a US incorporation and back-office platform, so running hiring and equity paperwork is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never shows Firstbase generating or managing offer letters, confidentiality/IP agreements, or option grants. The closest items are adjacent: a Carta integration for creating a cap table (a third-party handoff, not option-grant paperwork) and payroll registration for hiring (not hiring documents).

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can run hiring and equity paperwork — offer letters, confidentiality/IP agreements, and option grants — through the platform
